rss_feeds_articles.headline: Before pride drives the tractor through the fence
rss_feeds_articles.title: Before pride drives the tractor through the fence
rss_feeds_articles.excerpt:
Sagebrush was starting to encroach on a field my father-in-law had painstakingly cleared over the years. So this week, I climbed onto his old tractor and did some mowing, unsupervised. In rural Montana, that hardly qualifies as news, but I’m putting it on my résumé.

First, it’s bigger than a riding mower, which makes it a large tractor in my estimation. Second, it’s old. I believe it was originally built to pull a chariot.
